status_meaning: Correctness, source stability and benchmark completion checks; a PASS status does not mean every timing improved.
scope: CPU graph/query work, native R/RG readback and complete masked-material engine interactions; not viewport FPS

data.scope: All engine program signatures; CPU only, no GPU evaluation or viewport FPS

data.limitation: Actual Python node draw callbacks and RNA; native layout/rendering excluded, not displayed FPS.

native_readback.decision: Retain tiled CPU expansion only for existing native R/RG Device.readback buffers.
native_readback.limitation: Complete native readback operation, not normal RGBA image publication or viewport FPS. Probe retained medians only; raw per-sample timings were not written.

data.scope: GPU source acquisition for bounded fallback previews; includes readback, CPU copy and channel remapping, not full brush latency

bounded_cpu_preview.baseline: Previous full-size readback/copy/remap/shrink flow with tiled compact expansion already enabled. Incremental comparison, not the installed Round 3 implementation.
bounded_cpu_preview.limitation: Only CPU fallback previews acquiring a GPU resource. Direct GPU Canvas and CPU-image previews unchanged; not complete preview initialization or full brush latency.

rejected_scalar_publication.decision: Rejected: all six tested 2048 configurations were slower including final image upload/completion. No production flag added.

release_validation.scope: Complete Vulkan/OpenGL, CPU, pure-test, GUI, package, installation and fresh-start results are recorded separately.

performance_assessment.components: Paired CPU, native R/RG expansion and bounded preview acquisition probes improved in their stated scopes. Preview acquisition compares against the already tiled-expansion implementation.
performance_assessment.masked: Mixed outcomes. 2048 roughness wall median rose 57.15 to 100.55 ms (p95 183.96 ms), mask median remained 180.88 to 180.71 ms, forced republish fell 265.29 to 229.82 ms. No general masked-interaction gain is established.
performance_assessment.attribution: The two-fill masked fixture does not exercise bounded CPU-preview acquisition. Observed whole-material timing variation is preserved and not attributed to those targeted changes.
